description: Compares two versions of an OpenAPI or Protobuf contract with the built-in rules and reports breaking changes. Give two files (base, head), or base with the working-tree files to compare with their version at the merge base. Read-only; runs no external tool. Runs `devflow contracts diff --json`.

base.description: Compare the files with their version at the merge base of this ref and HEAD.

files.description: <base-file> <head-file>, or with base the files to compare.

kind.description: The contract kind, when the file name does not tell.

workspace.description: Absolute path of the workspace (the repository root). Default: the directory the MCP server was started in.

name: devflow_contracts_diff
title: Compare OpenAPI or Protobuf contracts
